assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production pixel-art four-frame drive animation sprite strip for an existing side-view WWII tank game. Edit target: the attached transparent 300 x 129 pixel partisan tank hull without its cannon. Produce ONE transparent horizontal sprite strip, exactly FOUR equal cells in ONE row, one identical-scale complete tank hull per cell, facing RIGHT, no barrel. Intended final cell size 300 x 129 (total 1200 x 129); if a larger output canvas is necessary use a strict 4:1 cell layout and equal cell dimensions with no extra header or gaps. Match the source's exact pixel-art style, olive palette, turret with RED FIVE-POINT STAR, silhouette, hull armor, wheel count, proportions, viewpoint, lighting, and right-facing identity. Hull and turret MUST stay completely motionless at the same relative cell coordinates and same scale in ALL FOUR cells. Animate ONLY the continuous tread links and rotational markings of the road wheels/sprockets through four sequential quarter-period phases of smooth forward rolling. At screen ground-contact edge the track links move left relative to hull; along upper return edge links move right. The effect must read clearly when a cell is displayed at 120-150 px wide. Frame four loops smoothly to frame one. This is in-place rolling, NO translation, bobbing, suspension bounce, recoil, dust, smoke, shadows, muzzle effects, scenery, numbers, text, labels, borders, or guide grid. Preserve transparent background and the existing hull's top and ground baseline consistently. Do not redesign the tank. Every frame must actually differ in visible tread phase; do not repeat the same frame.

Technical animation edit for an existing historical vehicle game asset. This is neutral asset production, with no advocacy or political message. Edit the supplied cannonless tank chassis illustration into a four-frame in-place mechanical rolling loop. Four equal cells in a single horizontal row, transparent background. Preserve the exact source design, side view facing left, charcoal-gray colors, existing small white cross marking, pixel-art rendering, same size and position of the hull and turret in each cell. Change only tread-link phases and rotational wheel markings in four incremental steps of a continuous cycle. Ground-contact track links move right relative to hull, top return links move left. Wheel centers and hull remain fixed in every frame. No added cannon, people, symbols, text, labels, borders, scenery or effects. Final intended cell size 327 by 137 pixels; the animation must remain legible at 121-pixel display width. Preserve true transparency.
